verdict.rationale: Granola's docs describe pre-meeting briefs prepared overnight: when you open the note as you join, you see a short brief with open threads, relevant context and agenda points. This is backed by a calendar connection that pulls upcoming meetings, and Chat can recall past meeting details on demand. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the brief surfaces prior meetings with the same attendees (only 'relevant context' is stated), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the brief feature.
